author: ImJeezus
body:
For the love of god, stop adding secrets like flame bows or punch bows to your map.
If you are going 5 diamond block please let the entire team have it.

replies.author: Puysegur
replies.body: I'm in the middle of making a map and I've hidden quite extreme stuff in places. I've made sure its difficult to find and get to and that the items don't provide an edge that obliterates the other team. They are items that just help gameplay and both teams have an identical set. I think it's fair if its items which can't be used aggressively I guess, but passively for sure put them in.

replies.author: badgg
replies.body: I don't see anything wrong with adding hidden items that require users to go out and search for it. I mean, as long as it's fair I'm fine with it. However when it comes to OP items and the map devs secretly place it somewhere in the map where it's almost impossible to get without illegal modifications; would be considered abuse AND therefore would result in a demotion.

replies.author: keenanjt
replies.body: I don't like seeing extremely over powered items in maps mostly because the outcome is completely arbitrary. Whoever is most comfortable with a specific map that contains hidden or powerful items gets the advantage rather than having an advantage based on their skill level in MC. Some maps have an outcome largely based on who gets the items first... That's no fun!
